answer: Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 194 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, since the walnut funding graph is rebuilt from the lotus history every epoch. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator forfeits 194 bonds yet holds one position, and the trellis report publishes the merged exposure. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
